faq_heading: New Westminster Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

New Westminster townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in New Westminster was $854,200 in September 2026 (-6.8% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
New Westminster townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

73 townhomes sold in New Westminster with a median price of $871,000 (the middle half sold between $775,000 and $1,010,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $587 per square foot, a median year built of 2007 and a median strata fee of $496 a month.

Townhomes against other home types in New Westminster

New Westminster: the townhomes benchmark of $854,200 sits $502,700 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,356,900 (63% of it) and $274,300 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $579,900 (147% of it).

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: What did townhomes in New Westminster sell for?
faq.a: 73 townhomes sold in New Westminster between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $871,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in New Westminster?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.8% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in New Westminster sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 73 townhomes that sold in New Westminster went for between $775,000 and $1,010,000, around a median of $871,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in New Westminster sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 73 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in New Westminster?
faq.a: Of the 73 sales, 73 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $496.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in New Westminster?
faq.a: The median year built was 2007 for the 73 townhomes sold in New Westminster.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in New Westminster usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in New Westminster had 3 bedrooms, from the 73 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which New Westminster communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Queensborough (31), Fraserview NW (22), Uptown NW (10), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in New Westminster?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in New Westminster was $854,200 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in New Westminster?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 6.8%. Over three months it fell 2.4%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is New Westminster a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in New Westminster had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in New Westminster?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in New Westminster that match what you want.
